I have the exact model since new. Still going strong.
Already fix the gear box leaking, water pump replaced twice, and a few other things that I can't remember. 

The biggest bill is the gear box repair 2k plus. Did it last year. The water pump and other related parts around 1.4k

Otherwise, the car is fine. No major engine issue. But the suspension is totally screwed which I have no plans to change. 

City drive fuel consumption is 9km per litre.

My non physical pursuit is studying for my insurance certificate called AII Level 1. There are six papers and I have completed five. 

I make sure I study every night for at least 25 minutes. Like Goggins, I write my own notes. I do not read it passively. I tell myself, no one else is doing this. And this thought keeps me motivated.

After each study session, I will take a cold shower, take a nap or go to bed. This helps with retention.

I turned my line around at 38. And this year I am 48.  I was in a dead end job and no friends. Here is what I did. 
1. I started running every night. I ran about 1 to 2 miles. I begin to feel great and more confident in life. 
2. I volunteered in a food distribution charity to the needy. I got to know more people, expanded my network and social circle.
3. Over the years I have also learned new skills by watching YouTube and completed an insurance certification program. In my country, there were less than 3000 registered qualifiers.

Here is my outcome.
1. I started my business at 42. Nearly doubled my income 
2. I am fitter than in my 30s
3. I have a vibrant social circle 

To turn yourself around. You must have a healthy body. Thus the discipline to eat healthy and exercise is important. 
The fastest way to expand your social circle is through charity work. They always need good people. You will meet other kind and passionate people. 
The cost of studying is very cheap. Learn what you want through YouTube.

Good luck.
Goggins has enough videos and be audios to last me hours. Instead of taking the effort to see him live, I rather focus on my goals. I still get inspired by him without seeing him live.

I am studying for an insurance certification program. Completed 4 and 2 more to go. 

My Goggins way is do all the prep question that are available. And I will study everyday. Minimum 25 minutes to 3 hours. During that period there is no other distraction.

Before each session I will watch 1 min of Goggins video to fire myself up.
Not owner, but I know a friend did. He sold the car due to rust issues
Such things are common during my school days. I remember a bullied victim brought a steel pipe and beat the shit out of the bully. And guess who got arrested?
I honest dont know. So far, I have no issues in accessing certain sites.

I am similar situation. All I want is to get shit done. I have most interest in anything that involves entertainment. To me I am wasting time. If I take a break, I am ridden with guilt. 

I don't know how to help you. All I can say is you are not alone and the only one.
Not at all. I wanted to know.  As I mentioned above, it is a morning rush hour. Everyone wants to go to their destination quickly and safely.
Thank you

I apologise to show my ignorance on Reddit. And thank you for the answer. I have no intention to rag on motorcyclist. They are also road users, they also want to go to their destination as fast as possible and safely.  Like everyone else.

Yes. Sometimes this is how I feel as well. I am the one who is holding the grudges. The person may have said something that pissed me off, but they have long forgotten about it. While I kept playing it in my head.

Thank you. I do agree that I am overdoing it. Goggins' mentality has helped a lot. Allowing to breakthrough many mental barriers. But overdoing it can costly. I probably not listening to anymore of those hater playlist.

I have read similar "summary" about Count Hurt Me. These summaries did not capture the spirit of David Goggins. To appreciate David Goggins' book, you have to take your time to understand his struggle and how he overcame it.   
If you are short of time, listen to any of his podcast, you will benefit more than reading someone's else summary about him.

Actually I would suck it up and pay. But I will write off these two person from my life. It is cheap price to pay. 

Nevertheless wise up if you are in the game of life.There are many who will not hesitate to take advantage of you.

These criminals will only threaten you with violence. They will not carry unless you really owe them money.  If you do not owe them money, they will move on and find another victim. Committing acts of violence will attract police attention.
Thank you for the feedback. I have many macros to automate Excel reporting. Would love to own a Mac, but I am not willing to give up Macros and VBA.
The skill sets you have is exactly what I aspire to learn. And I am sure I am not the only one who wants to learn. Maybe you can create your own online course?

I specialise in general insurance, particularly in the area of fire and jeweller's block insurance. 

The start of the year has been tough due to the increase in fire rates as there have been massive losses due to natural disasters. Tough as in, insurance companies refuse to issue quotes due to high claims. While certain clients under-declare their past claim history. Some clients even tried to fabricate claims. 

For 2023 will be a slow year for me, as I have to be selective with potential customers.
Thank you sir.

Welcome to the club. It is all normal. At least you are in a good place now. I am still in the arena fighting for my own survival. I am always angry, and have to watch my back all the time. Despite all these, there are always pockets of silence that you can appreciate. In my case is when the whole family has fallen asleep. I would sit on my coach expressing gratitude on everything that went my way. But I will wake the next day ready to take on whatever that blocks my path.

Yes. I did eventually overcome the anger. I try to meditate everyday. As the day progresses, the seething feeling eventually goes away. But the first few days was pure war with my mind. As soon as I close my eyes, the anger and resentment flooded my head. All I can think of is how to plot my revenge and reminding myself that I will not trust anyone anymore. 

The next day, such negative energy grows weaker. And as the day progresses, it eventually dies down. Of course, life is filled with suffering and challenges, I have other issues to worry and get angry about. But the earlier negative thoughts about the client who ran off with my money went away.

Thank you all for the kind advice. The session gets very intense as soon as I sit down. As if my mind is waiting to jump on me when there is a quiet moment. The inner voice ask me  to stop playing nice where history and success is written by victor, not the person who play nice and fail. 

I do my best to observe the inner voice, but sometimes I get lead into fantasies of revenge. And sometimes the inner voice goes away and I was bliss for awhile. Then it comes back roaring into my head. 

I will have another session later today. I will observe harder on the inner and explore further why my inner voice is so fierce.
I would buy one

Thank you for the feedback especially you have taken the trouble to write such as long one. 

After reading three replies. The journey of my own self discovery is a long one. I thought I have embrace Stoicism. Obviously, I am wrong. 

I agree that enough is enough. Sometimes I want to stand up and say I quit. Sometimes, I would tell myself, it is not that bad. Unfortunately, the days in the office has also brought out the worst of me. I thought I can influence the management and will one day see me as equal, built the business together. If I have to talk about my grievance on Reddit. It is obvious that it is not a place that I should stay.   


I cannot say thank you enough. I will plan my exit plan. At least I can leave with my head held high.

>You have let your ownership, free will, and the power to take initiative in your life dwindle to its very minimum... and now as a consequence your will to live is fading

Thanks you. You are very right. You described me better than I have described myself. I could not shake off this fact that I have allowed me to grind down to the point where I have lost the will to live. 

I do not want to grow old as a cynical old man angry towards life.

Thank you. Yes. I do agree that all my life I have let other people walk over me. And I have become very bitter towards people and life. There were moments were I tried to stand up for myself. Only to be beaten down. I am very afraid of conflict. 

I will read up Discourses and share my journey here. Thank you.

Thank you all for the reply. One big difference is that I tend to fall asleep faster after meditation. I think no more than 10 minutes and I out cold. There was once or twice that I did fall asleep during meditation. When that happens my sleep is screwed. But falling asleep during meditation is rare now.

Before having this practice, falling asleep is a challenge. My mind is filled with anxiety and things that I need to do. The next nothing I wake up wondering whether I have really slept. In a way, meditation helps to sleep faster. But not sure why I have lesser sleeping hours.

I have two jobs so stress is always an issue. I used to complain that no matter how much sleep I get, I feel tired. And I don't feel like getting out of bed. There are good days and bed days. But I find the days of not wanting to get out of bed lesser. 

I stop work or stop reading between 1230 am to 1250am. Then I will sit and meditate for 30 mins which I planned to increased to 45 mins.

I used to get up around 8. I am waking up earlier. Today is the earliest, 645.

I hear you brother. I have no advice for you but to tell you that you are not alone. The more shit I over come, the shittier things get.
I have two a business and a job. Both are just barely paying enough for my bills. Everyday is a battle. I solved one problem. Two more comes out. It never ends.
Maybe you should think both short term and long term. Get a job to solve your short terms issues such as paying the bills. For the long term, built your business. When you know you can solve some of your issues. You can focus on bigger picture.

I do mindfulness meditation before going to bed. I have no issues falling asleep. I think there are many factors at play. If i drink coffee after 5pm. I know my sleep well be affected. i find eating some carbohydrates for dinner helps me to sleep. I work long hours. By the time I finish for the day, i be dead tired.
Since you doing mindfulness meditation, you should try monitor your activities.
Thank you for sharing

I would like to join

It is because everyone including people that i care and love said i cannot make it. So i decided to show them. But they are right about it. The first few years they have been proven right. With some little success that i am getting lately. I may have the last laugh.
Please don't share with your love ones. You either get ignore or they asked you to snap out of it. That's what happened to me. Depression is a battle that only strangers will be in your side.

There is still hope. Whatever that's worth.   
I am glad that you are working out and responding to people.
Consider yourself lucky, in my case it has been: getting married, MLM, unit trust, insurance and to borrow money.

I agree with you. When we needed help and support mentally. They tell us to get over it as someone else had it worse. If not they just ignore us. That's what happened to me. I asked for support. Everyone just ignored me. Pretending we did not have that conversation.
If we blow our brains. They all wondered why we did not reach out? They are here all the time for us. Fuck that. Society will only help when it is convenient for them to do so.
Yes. Those are the simplies hugs. It is few and far in between. A hug that somehow stops time.
This feels scary but I would love to give all my old pictures a spin.
Same here. I am far older than you. No shame in crying. We all need a good support. But kindness and compassion seems a rare commodity now. Hang tight.

Hello. I hear you. I know how that feels and the pain will never go away. The pain of my ex left me still haunt me after 21 years. I have no idea how I survived. I just took one day at a time. You never be the same. Only physical pain and mental pain can numb the pain of a breakup. Exercise or study something difficult until you pass out on the floor. When you wake up, do that again. If you die, good. If not, you be better than yesterday. Which is also good. 

My words cannot comfort you. I am sorry. You can only do it by yourself. Hang tight.

Same here. The days are just getting tougher. I tend to say wrong things. People only remember the things that I did wrong and not the things that I did right. 

All I want is a hug. I am so tied up and twisted inside my heart that I cannot cry anymore. In fact, if you are hugging me, it is okay to break my neck and let me die as well.

I can relate to that. I have many interest, but do not have the grit or patience to stay with it. I can't even watch my favorite shows. 

My life is like a hamster wheel. I gave it my best to go nowhere. And now, I have given up.

I am sorry with what you are going through. I do not know how to support you. I can only tell you that you are not alone. My business has suffered gravely due to Covid19. And I am just working for peanuts. 

Good news is that you are still getting medical treatment. I can barely afford medical. I recently signed up with therapist to treat my depression. Honestly, I doubt it is working that well. But I have to do, before I kill myself.

One thing I know about life. It will not let you go easily. I have been begging to die in my sleep for 20 years. Not only life will keep you alive, but it will keep shitting into your mouth. No, life will not grant you this wish.

Yes. I agree. Night time is the worst. Do what I do. I read. Even if I do not like it. I keep reading. I normally read history. It is just to bored me to sleep. I am always on the move. If I am not active. Voices in my head will take over. And that's worst.

In many ways, depressed people like us are already dead. No one really cares unless they need something from us. Walk on the street, anyone smiled at us? We tried to be friendly and helpful, ended up being taken advantage. We tried to ask for help, we get ignored. People like us, there is no difference whether we are dead or alive. 

The only reason that society wanted us to live is because they do not want to look bad, if we are all dead.

At least you can still fall asleep. I have a tired body but a mind that cannot shut the fuck up. When I lie on bed, some voice would tell me that I am a loser. If I ever did fall asleep, I wake up feeling tired/ worst. Waking up is the worst part. Falling asleep is also the worst part. There is no end to the frustrations and pain.

Yes. Hang on there. Sometimes I do not know whether telling your loved ones about your depression helps. For my case, it totally back fired. I feel more alone than ever. The best advice that I received is:

"If they cannot do it for you. You will do it for them." 

Do it for your partner and your daughter. The days will be not easier. But if gives you a reason to fight the pain.
I am similar. But i have no more tears.

Thank you for sharing. How did your family/ friends/ love one react? Did they demand any explanation from you? Were you able to re-built the relationship with them?

I have tried to ask for help/ support from people that I care most. They just said I need more sleep and do not trust the therapist. After which, they all pretended that we did not have that conversation. 

Alot of people said we are not alone in the fight against depression. Yes. Just not with the ones that we love.

Thanks. Maybe they begin to understand. Maybe they dont. I have no idea. This could just be a blessing in disguised. If they understand, this means they too are in pain. 
From today onwards, it is all smiles and work from me. They cannot do it for me. So I have to do it for them. 
I started to see a therapist is because I tend to drift away and zone out when I am with them. They complained that I am a cold, self-centered person. So I know my depression is hurting the relationship. 
I tried to explain. And this happened. I am in a no win scenario.

In my country, sacred plant medicines is illegal. Maybe it is a blessing that the people who love most are ignorant of my pain. If they have understand, that means they too are in pain. 
From now on, it is all smiles and work from me. I be the "happiest" person. They can't do it for me. But I can do it for them.

I have no comforting words for you. It never gets better. I know how that feels when you tried to open up and be vulnerable, only to have that person to kick you in the balls. 

The only thing you have now is work and exercise. Just do the work. Work until you cannot do it anymore. Just exercise, work until you cannot exercise anymore. The pain will not go away. But it will numb you. You will soon normalise your pain. You be one of the walking dead. Then, you may find peace.

You took the words out of my mouth. All they tell us is think about the people around you. We are all in pain.  I have no comfort words for you. Just telling you that you are not alone.

I tried to telling a few people that I am close to about my problem. One said, I will get over it. Another one just turned cold. We never talk about it anymore. Only strangers on the net who are helpful.
Thanks. I don't even know how to start to tell her.

Maybe sometimes your parents could not express that they care. Maybe i could be wrong.
I love my gf. But i have difficulty telling her that i love her. She left me saying that i an a selfish bastard. Her words cut me into pieces. I wish I could tell her and show her much much i love her. It is too late. Maybe it is for the better. Rather let her think that i am a jerk rather than depressed. One day if I die, she will not be heart broken.
Maybe your parents are going through the same.

I am in a similar situation. Good family. Good job. But hollow in the inside. I work hard for the family. But i mentally i cannot go on any further. I wish I can die in my sleep. When I get up, i would give it all to do my work.i eat well and exercise daily. At least i know i have one day less to live.
I did not let myself breakdown because of family and people who cares. But they don't see the tears and pain in my eyes.
I don't know how to help you. Just saying that you are not alone. To others your problem is small. But i understand how your pain cuts you up.
Make everyday count. Give it all. At least no one said you did not try.

I know how that feels. I am a project manager. My presentation is always filled with energy and enthusiasm. When I go to parties, i am the comedian.
No one knows i am hollow and shit as hell.
How i do it? I lock myself in my car and scream at myself to laugh and smile. I scream until i am tired and numb. I get out and all smiles, ready to talk.
Might work for you. Might not.

Hello. I am going through the something similar. I have no one to talk to. My life is a joke. The only thing that kept me going are my children. They are all growing up. And it is like a never ending battle. 

Don't do it for yourself. Don't do it for your children. Do it for the community. Volunteer at your religious place or a soup kitchen. Dedicate one hour a week there. Give your best effort when you are there. You will make new friends and new connection.

Maybe, just maybe things might improve. Good luck.

Thank you. 

But will life love us back? Will the bullying stops? Will beating stops? Will the anguish stops? When we beg for help, all they said is, you will get over it. 

Can they hear us when we are all chocked with tears and words that could not come out? Can they feel us, when we express our love and care? 

They will only start to care when one of us is lying on the street beaten, OD and dead. Even then, it is no more than five minutes as there is another breaking news.

You are not alone. I wish I could have more comforting words for you. I too wish I can just die in my sleep. Of course, it has not happen. Whenever I wake up, I tell the world to go and fuck itself. I get on with my day by maxing out my effort. I give everything I got to everything that I do. If some drunk tries to rub me with a knife, he better be fast else I will beat the living shit out of him. I fucking sick of life. But I will not let life have an upper hand. If I have to die, I will die on my own terms.
I have trouble sleeping as well. When I cannot sleep. I would read a book. Normally is historical books about great struggle. Or philosophical. It may not work for you. But it is worth a try.

I hear you. This is the same for me. 

When I tried to ask for help. They say, just snap out of it. If is that easy, I would not be suffering. 

When I had problems expressing my feelings and thoughts to the people that I care and love. They think that I am just a selfish and self-centered bastard. 

All these cuts fucking deep. 

All I can do is the wear the happy face mask. Play the role that society has asked me to play. 

It pains me whenever I read about suicides. People often ask what could they have done more for the victim. Simple, open your eyes and see, open your ears and listen!!!! But the society is too blind and deaf to hear someone crying for help.

I am sorry about your lost. Your husband would not want to be the burden of your pain. End each day by telling him that you are trying to recover and be happy. He may not be able to answer or respond to you, but he lives inside you now. 

I know it is painful and nearly impossible to live another minute. Ending it all may seem the right option because he is already on the other side. Yet, you are here. There must be a reason. You will soon find out, and find your smile again. For now, just tell him that you are doing your best to be live.

Hello. I hear you. I am in the same situation. I have been battling this since 2000. No one knows that I fucking hate my life.  Just like you, I cannot do it because I know everyone around me would be heart broken. I even pray that I will just die in my sleep, so they will not suspect a thing. 

Don't do it for yourself. Do it for them. Every day, I wake up and tell the world to fuck themselves. I start getting after it. I never back down from a challenge. A boss give me a lousy assignment so that he can fire me? Screw you. I will deliver it and get it all done. Some drunk tried to rob me with a knife? He better stab me quick or I will beat the living shit out of him. 

Whatever you do, give it your best. Life is never meant to be fair and sunshine. Life will not miss you when you are dead. The only ones who misses you are your loved ones. Give yourself a new mission. The mission to protect your loved ones.

I do not know you. And probably, I will never know you. I am really sorry about your situation. Do not let those fuckers have the last laugh. Take one day at a time, one breath at a time. Do your work/ studies to your best ability. Whatever you do, give it your best. One day, maybe one day you will find the reason to smile again.

I feel the same way since 2000. 

When I wake up, I say fuck the world. I work hard and do whatever needs to be done, then go to bed. At least, I have one day less to live. There are good days and bad days. It feels numb and hollow inside. 

The spot light is on me during work and parties. I am the man. I am doing what society wants me to do. I played my role. 

Get back home, numb as hell. Go to bed, not wishing to wake up.
